newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyo Aluminium blast halts powder output.
newsitem.headline: Toyo Aluminium blast halts powder output.

text.p: Toyo Aluminium KK said on Wednesday that an explosion at its Hino factory last Friday halted output of aluminium powder, although on Monday it resumed shipments from inventories.
The Hino plant, in Tokyo, produces 6,500 to 7,000 tonnes per year of aluminium powder, 1,200 tonnes per year of aluminium alloy powder and 60 tonnes per year of high-purity nitride aluminium powder.

Output of alloy powder and nitride aluminium powder would resume by March 10, the company said, following an inspection of facilities. It was unclear, however, when output of aluminium powder would resume.

A spokesman said the company did not yet have any estimates for costs or lost output due to the accident, although it expected to continue supplying customers through cooperation with other producers and through procurement from overseas subsidiaries in the United States and Europe.
